title: Lamar Jackson leaves stadium in walking boot, reportedly day-to-day with ankle injury from Ravens win over Titans

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Lamar Jackson leaves stadium in walking boot, reportedly day-to-day with ankle injury from Ravens win over Titans
sources.description: Lamar Jackson left Sunday's game with an ankle injury and was replaced at the start of the second half by backup Tyler Huntley.
